assessment: This important study provides a state-of-the-art framework to explore the coupling of complementary cerebral measures (neural, hemodynamic and metabolic) during development by providing an interesting roadmap for multimodal neuroimaging in infants. The methodological contribution is compelling with an original setup for simultaneous EEG and NIRS recording and analyses. Results on the role of activation changes in the temporal-parietal junction on the development of social processing are convincing. This work will be of interest to a broad audience of scientists interested in multimodal neuroimaging and cognitive development.
